prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object in view, approach it. If near, take it. Do task or scan.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = DoTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <SubTree ID = DoTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO DoTask
	END
